instruction: Write an XDP program that must remap customer VLAN identifier 120 to internal transport VLAN 220 in-place. Modify the TCI field in-place without adjusting packet head. Forward all packets with XDP_PASS.
requirements: Verify Ethernet and 802.1Q header bounds against data_end
Check if eth->h_proto == ETH_P_8021Q and vlan_id == 120
Overwrite vlan->h_vlan_TCI in-place preserving priority bits and setting VID to 220
SEC("xdp") entry point and GPL license declaration
